source: host ship round without Grok Bot
note: Dry mode prints the bootstrap plan and writes nothing. The host clone is $TSV_DISPATCH_ROOT/ship-repo. Each round fetches origin/vk and hard-checks it out. It re-execs that copy only when its SHIP_ROUND_VERSION is the same or newer than the installed script. An older copy stays on the installed bootstrap. A no-UI diff whose secrets and unit-tests are green gets Gate B SKIPPED_BACKEND_ONLY success. A diff that touches UI files does not. The first round ships 1042, then 1040 at d816927d, then 1044 at 6512f9bd when those pulls are still open: labels, acceptance file, accept on that exact green head, and merge when the PR is clean. Merged pulls are skipped. Every round reads tip from origin/vk and live from the staging version sha, including when no pull is open. When tip equals live and that live SHA has no completed dry-run record, the round runs python3 live_accept.py run and exactly one dry run, then rings the doorbell with the verdict. The dry-run step alone loads DATABASE_URL from the host pulled env files, or from the staging DATABASE_URL vercel id using ~/.config/tsv-deploy/vercel-token and the team and project ids in tsv_dispatch.py, and sets HARNESS_LIVE=1 for that step. The ship repo runs npm ci --no-audit --no-fund when node_modules is missing or package-lock.json changes, and stamps the lock hash under state. A missing module is blocked: env with that module name and does not record the live SHA. Dry-run ids are lowercase harness tags. A harness exception before a scorecard is stored as its message with verdict FAIL and blocked: env, and does not record the live SHA. Dialog model stamps and the renderer both read dialog-runners/tier_models.json. An unknown model still refuses. A fixed opener is marked non-model greeting. The first intake reply always keeps the deterministic collaborator copy: building the itinerary, view access, edit access, an email invite, and unlimited vacations for the whole year. The dry run loads TIMESYNCHER_MEDIA_BIND_TOKEN from ~/.config/tsv-deploy/media-bind-token when the process env does not have it. A missing file is blocked: env and does not record the live SHA. A SKIP or missing env does not record the SHA and rings blocked: env. A failed dry run retries only after a new live SHA, a merge, or a prior skip. Deploy is python3 tsv_dispatch.py --batch-deploy only after a merge. A stale head is not accepted. A PR dirty only because both sides appended scripts/offline-tests.txt is marked needs-rebase and is not patched. The same live SHA does not get a second dry run. Cleanup remaining other than 0 fails. The doorbell stays silent when the failure reason repeats.

assertions.note: Accept, stale head, rebase, one dry run per SHA, cleanup, and doorbell rules.
